title: Gurbakhsh Singh Offers His Head in Combat

blocks.text: The battle now narrows to Gurbakhsh Singh's body itself. With the spears was Singhs body pressed down, and though he was forced toward his knees by sheer weight and numbers, Even then he did not lose his hold on his sword.

The narration emphasizes that he fears only one thing: that delay or disarmament might deprive him of the sacrifice he has chosen. Would he be deprived of his cherished sacrifice becomes the silent question underneath the scene as he measures how to turn collapse into martyrdom.

Then the moment arrives. He bowed down his head before an attacking Pathan in conscious imitation of earlier Sikh martyrdoms, and Instantly his head was severed from his body, completing the wedding with death that had been prepared throughout the episode.
